declarations.name: KgdiffViewer
declarations.description:
The drop-in viewer: a root (`KgdiffRootElement`) with the default layout, the canvas with its chrome, the change list, the search, the filters and the detail panel.

`header="compact"` leaves the brand and the compared names out of the canvas, for hosts that show their own (such as the playground): the preset `panels="title:hidden"`. `sidebar="closed"` starts with the sidebar folded (`\` and the sidebar button open it).

A small looping replay for another page: `mode="replay" chrome="none" loop` (with a height of your choosing, such as 320px).

The canvas has the slots of `<kgdiff-stage>` (`top-start`, `top-end`, `bottom-start`, `bottom-center`, `bottom-end`; the top ones under the title and the actions while those show): a child with `slot="top-end"` goes over the canvas, kept clear of fits and flights. A chrome element slotted in replaces the built-in region of its kind, the title and the actions included; `<kgdiff-zoom>` and `<kgdiff-minimap>` inside the viewer act on its canvas.

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: Reflected to the `mode` attribute. Default `overlay`.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Reflected to the `scope` attribute. Default `all` (`changes` for large graphs). Fixed to `changes` when the layout covers only the changes.

attributes.name: theme
attributes.description: Reflected to the `theme` attribute. Default `auto`.

attributes.name: palette
attributes.description: Reflected to the `palette` attribute. Default `default`.

attributes.name: locale
attributes.description: Reflected to the `locale` attribute. Default from `navigator.language`.

attributes.name: sync-hash
attributes.description: Keep the selection, mode and scope in the page's URL hash (`#kgdiff=hunk:<id>;mode:<mode>;scope:<scope>`) and follow it: deep links.

attributes.name: loop
attributes.description: Reflected to the boolean `loop` attribute. In `replay` mode the replay plays by itself and starts again `loopDelay` ms after it ends. `pause()` stops it until `play()`. Default false.

attributes.name: loop-delay
attributes.description: Reflected to `loop-delay`: ms between the end of a looping replay and its restart. Default 1200.

attributes.name: pause-on-hover
attributes.description: With `loop`, the replay pauses while the pointer is over the graph and continues when it leaves (a mouse or pen; not touch). Reflected as `pause-on-hover="false"` when off. Default true.

attributes.name: shortcuts
attributes.description: Reflected to the `shortcuts` attribute: where the keyboard shortcuts apply. `scoped` (the default): while focus is inside the root, or in an element bound to it with `for` (those forward their keys). `global`: also when nothing on the page has focus (for full-page viewers such as HTML reports), for the first such root, except the keys pages scroll with (arrows, Home / End, Page Up / Down, Space); the boolean `global-shortcuts` attribute is an alias. `none`: no shortcuts (a focused change list keeps its arrow keys, Home / End and Enter).

attributes.name: keymap
attributes.description: Single keys of the keyboard map bound to another shortcut, or unbound with `null`: `{ x: null, r: 'review' }`. The `keymap` attribute takes the same as text, `"x:none r:review"` (`Space` names the space bar). Keys are `KeyboardEvent.key` values; a letter stands for both its cases unless the other case is named too; keys not named keep the default map; entries naming no shortcut are ignored with a warning.
attributes.experimental: The shortcut names (`ShortcutName`) are new in 0.6.

attributes.name: sidebar
attributes.description: A preset: `closed` starts with the sidebar folded (`\` and the sidebar button open it), `open` with its four regions open. Reflects the sidebar's state once the user toggles it.

attributes.name: header
attributes.description: A preset: `compact` leaves the brand and the compared names out of the canvas, for hosts that show their own (`panels="title:hidden"`).

attributes.name: chrome
attributes.description: Reflected to the `chrome` attribute. `none` shows the graph alone: no title, actions, view dock (with the step caption and playback bar), change list, zoom buttons, minimap or legend card; the hover tooltip and a one-line legend stay. Clicks and keyboard shortcuts do nothing, the minimum height drops from 420px to 120px, and the view stays fitted: when the canvas is resized (unless the user panned or zoomed since) and at the start of every loop. Labels are never cut at the edge: one pushed from its spot by a neighbour moves inside or is left out. Default `full`.

attributes.name: legend
attributes.description: Reflected to the `legend` attribute: `full` (the card), `mini` (one line: the families this diff has, then unchanged), `none`. Default `auto`: `full`, or `mini` with `chrome="none"`.

attributes.name: panels
attributes.description: The page's declaration of panel states, reflected to the `panels` attribute: a string (`"detail:collapsed minimap:hidden"`) or an object (`{ detail: 'collapsed' }`); reading it gives the object. Regions not named keep their state; entries that name no region or state are ignored with a warning. It wins over what the user chose before (remembered) and a report's `view.panels`; the user can still open and close collapsed regions, and declaring the same again keeps what they did. The presets `sidebar="closed"` (list, detail, search and filters collapsed), `header="compact"` (title hidden) and `chrome="none"` (everything but the canvas and the legend hidden) are panel states too; `panels` wins over them for the regions it names. The states every region has now are in `layout`.

attributes.name: persist
attributes.description: Reflected to the `persist` attribute. `local` (the default): the layout remembers the user's panel states, sizes, theme, palette and language in `localStorage` (under `persistKey`, shared by the viewers of the origin with the same key). `none`: it remembers nothing.

attributes.name: persist-key
attributes.description: Reflected to the `persist-key` attribute: the `localStorage` key the layout remembers under. Viewers with the same key share what they remember; give each app on a shared origin (a GitHub Pages user site, say) a key of its own. Default `kgdiff:viewer`.

attributes.name: global-shortcuts
attributes.description: The same as `shortcuts="global"`.

events.name: kgdiff-ready
events.description: A diff is shown, from `load()` or a `payload`; `stats` counts its nodes, edges and changes.

events.name: kgdiff-select

type.text: CustomEvent<{ readonly hunk: string | null; readonly node: string | null }>

events.description: The selection changed: a change (`hunk`, its id, with the node chosen in it if any), a node alone (`hunk` null), or nothing (both null).

events.name: kgdiff-mode

type.text: CustomEvent<{ readonly mode: ViewerMode; readonly scope: ViewerScope }>

events.description: The mode or the scope changed, by the user, a key or the host.

events.name: kgdiff-review

type.text: CustomEvent<{ readonly hunk: string; readonly reviewed: boolean; readonly progress: ReviewState; }>

events.description: A change was marked reviewed, or not; `progress` is the review state after it.

events.name: kgdiff-error
events.description: Loading or showing a diff failed; `error` is a `KgdiffError` for bad input.

events.name: kgdiff-replay-end
events.description: Playback reached the end of the replay (not fired for seeking or stepping there). `loop`: it starts again after `loopDelay` ms; set `loop = false` or call `pause()` to stop it.

events.name: kgdiff-layout
events.description: The default layout changed: a panel opened, collapsed or was hidden, or a size changed (once a drag ends). `source`: the user did it in the viewer, or the host (attributes, properties, a report's `view.panels`).

slots.name: top-start
slots.description: The page's content over the canvas, top left (under the title while it shows).

slots.name: top-end
slots.description: The page's content over the canvas, top right (under the actions while they show).

slots.name: bottom-start
slots.description: The page's content over the canvas, bottom left, above the legend.

slots.name: bottom-center
slots.description: The page's content above the view dock and the transport.

slots.name: bottom-end
slots.description: The page's content over the canvas, bottom right, above the zoom buttons and the minimap.

declarations.name: KgdiffRoot
declarations.description:
A root without visuals. It owns the session and provides it to the elements inside it (`<kgdiff-stage>`, `<kgdiff-change-list>`, …) or naming it with `for`, and owns what they share: the keyboard map, the live region announcing navigation, the events and the theme tokens. It has the attributes, properties, methods and events of `<kgdiff-viewer>` except the layout's (`panels`, `sidebar`, `header`, `chrome`, `legend`, `persist`): the page lays the elements out, and nothing is remembered.

It renders as `display: contents`, so its children are laid out by the page as if it were not there.

declarations.name: KgdiffStage
declarations.description:
The canvas of the root it is bound to: the graph, the hover tooltip, the swipe divider, the replay caption and the canvas chrome (view dock, replay transport, legend, zoom buttons and minimap). Each stage is a view of its own: a root draws every stage bound to it, each with its own camera, sharing the selection, the hover, the filters and the search; `version` pins one to a version.

Five named slots take the page's content over the canvas. The stage positions it (12–16 px from the edges, stacked further from the corner than the chrome there), and every slotted element is an obstacle: fits and flights frame the graph in the free part of the canvas. A chrome element slotted in replaces the built-in region of its kind; `panels` keeps applying to the rest. Content positioned some other way registers itself with `registerObstacle`, on the element or on the stage context (`kgdiff.stage/1`) it provides to its descendants.

attributes.name: for
attributes.description: Reflects the `for` attribute, as on `<label>` and `<output>`: the id of the root to show, or '' (no attribute; setting '' removes it) for the nearest one around the element. Changing it binds again.

attributes.name: panels
attributes.description: The states of the built-in chrome (`dock`, `transport`, `legend`, `zoom`, `minimap`), reflected to the `panels` attribute, in the syntax of `<kgdiff-viewer>`'s `panels`: `"minimap:hidden zoom:hidden"` or `{ minimap: 'hidden' }`; reading it gives the object. Other regions are ignored with a warning. Default: all open, the legend collapsed.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Reflected to the `version` attribute: the version this stage draws whatever the root's mode, `before` or `after` (two stages of one root side by side), or null to follow the mode. Another value is ignored with a warning. Each stage has its own camera; the selection, hover, filters and search are the root's, so both bring the same change into view.

members.description: The states of the built-in chrome (`dock`, `transport`, `legend`, `zoom`, `minimap`), reflected to the `panels` attribute, in the syntax of `<kgdiff-viewer>`'s `panels`: `"minimap:hidden zoom:hidden"` or `{ minimap: 'hidden' }`; reading it gives the object. Other regions are ignored with a warning. Default: all open, the legend collapsed.

declarations.description: Node search, a combobox and the results list it owns (its `aria-controls` and `aria-activedescendant` stay inside the element). The results open below the box while the query is not blank; ↑ / ↓ move through them, Enter chooses one (its node and change are selected, and focus moves to the change list), Esc clears. Registers itself as the root's `search` focus target: `/` focuses the one registered last that is shown.

declarations.name: KgdiffViewDock
declarations.description: How the root's diff is viewed. The mode (overlay, swipe, replay; keys `1`–`3`) and "Changes only" (key `4`) with its context hops and the nearest "+N" expansion. Binds to a root like the other elements (`for`, `htmlFor`, `rootElement`). Slotted into a `<kgdiff-stage>` it replaces the stage's built-in dock; placed anywhere else it is not kept clear of fits and flights unless registered (`stage.registerObstacle`).

declarations.name: KgdiffTransport
declarations.description: The replay transport of the root's diff. Previous, play / pause, next, the scrubber with one tick per change, the position and the speed; at the end, "Replay finished · Restart" above it. Shown in replay mode only. Binds to a root (`for`, `htmlFor`, `rootElement`). Slotted into a `<kgdiff-stage>` (`slot="bottom-center"`, say) it replaces the stage's built-in transport; placed anywhere else it is not kept clear of fits and flights unless registered. Importing this module defines it.

declarations.name: KgdiffLegend
declarations.description: What the colors mean. `variant="full"` (the default): a card of every family's swatch and name, folded to its head until opened; `open` reflects whether it is (the user's toggle included, as on `<details>`). `variant="mini"`: one line of dots for the families the root's diff has, then the unchanged context. Binds to a root (`for`, `htmlFor`, `rootElement`). Slotted into a `<kgdiff-stage>` it replaces the stage's built-in legend; placed anywhere else it is not kept clear of fits and flights unless registered.

declarations.name: KgdiffZoom
declarations.description: Zoom in, zoom out and fit, for one stage's view (the `+` / `−` / `f` keys act on every stage of the root). Binds to the nearest `<kgdiff-stage>` around it, or to the one `stage="<id>"` names (`stage`, `stageElement`, `rootElement`). Slotted into a stage it replaces the stage's built-in zoom buttons; placed anywhere else it is not kept clear of fits and flights unless registered.

declarations.name: KgdiffMinimap
declarations.description: An overview of one stage's view, with the part in view outlined. While the whole graph is in view it has nothing to add: it is in the custom state `overview` then (`:state(overview)`, and the read-only `overview` property). A minimap the page places stays shown (`kgdiff-minimap:state(overview) { visibility: hidden }` hides it without moving the layout); one slotted into a stage replaces the stage's own and hides as it did. Binds to the nearest `<kgdiff-stage>` around it, or to the one `stage="<id>"` names (`stage`, `stageElement`, `rootElement`). Slotted into a stage it replaces the stage's built-in minimap; placed anywhere else it is not kept clear of fits and flights unless registered.
